description.value: Mo's Restaurant is a Port Hardy institution with over 24 years serving the community at the northern tip of Vancouver Island. The menu centres on freshly made pizza with a broad selection of toppings, alongside Greek pita wraps, gyros, donairs, fried chicken, chicken wings, salads, and soups. For cycle tourers reaching the end of the island route, it offers a well-rounded comfort-food stop with both pickup and delivery options.
